newsitem.title: ALBANIA: EUROPE AND CIS PORT CONDITIONS - LLOYDS.
newsitem.headline: EUROPE AND CIS PORT CONDITIONS - LLOYDS.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
ALBANIA, Aug 5 - Durres - Five vessels in port operating, all discharging, of which 3 cement, 1 general cargo, 1 bagged flour. No vessels waiting in roads.

BULGARIA, Aug 3 - Varna east/Varna west/Balchik - 38 Vessels operating in port of which 22 loading (8 soda, 2 scrap, 3 clinker, 2 cement, 3 urea, 1 sunflower seeds, 2 fertiliser, 1 metals). 6 Discharging (1 soya fodder/maize, 3 phosphorite, 2 coal). 10 Discharging/loading (3 trucks/containers, 7 containers). 7 Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 to load (1 clinker, 1 scrap, 1 tsp), 1 to discharge phosphorite, 2 to discharge/load containers, 1 cargo not nominated. Bourgas - Aug 4 - Five vessels in port operating of which 3 loading (1 steel, 1 ammonium nitrate, 1 clinker), 2 discharging (1 maize, 1 iron ore). 2 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 to load ferro silicon, 1 for redelivery. 8 Vessels due of which 3 to load steel. 5 To discharge (1 iron ore, 1 coke, 1 coal, 1 sugar, 1 salt). No strikes.

Varna - Varna east - 4 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 1 vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge. Varna west - 11 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchor to load, 1 bunkering. Lesport/tanker port - No vessels. Bourgas - Bourgas east - 3 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth. 12 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge, 4 under repair/dry-docked, 1 awaiting orders. 14 Vessels due. Bourgas west - 3 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth. Tanker port - 1 Vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth.

CYPRUS, Aug 5 - Limassol - Four container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 1 conventional vessel discharging at berth. 12 Vessels due by 6/8 of which 4 containers, 3 conventional vessels, 5 passenger vessels. Larnaca - One container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth. 3 Vessels due by 6/8 of which 2 containers, 1 conventional vessel.

ESTONIA, Aug 5 - No labour problems. Tallinn - City port - 1 Cellulose vessel loading at berth, 1 liner. 2 Vessels due, no delays expected. Kopli - 2 Vessels loading at berth (1 sawn timber, 1 non-ferrous metals), 1 frozen meat vessel discharging at berth. 6 Vessels due, no delays expected. Muuga - 5 Vessels loading at berth (3 fuel oil, 1 benzene, 1 timber). 3 Discharging at berth (1 sugar, 1 barley, 1 poultry). 1 Vessel awaiting orders, 8 due, no delays expected. Parnu - Five vessels loading at berth (3 timber, 1 general cargo, 1 peat/moss). 5 Vessels due, no delays expected.

ITALY, Aug 5 - Naples, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Gaeta - One bulk carrier ETB 5/8, 1 bulk carrier ETB 7/8. Genoa - Commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays. 18 Vessels berthed, 4 dry-docked. Multedo - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, none berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays. 2 Vessels berthed. Vado Ligure No vessels in roads, no delays. 1 Vessel berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays. 5 Vessels berthed, 5 under repair/dry-docked. Leghorn - Five vessels in roads, 27 berthed. Civitavecchia, Ancona/Falconara, Venice - No delays. Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo - No vessels in roads, no delays. Oil harbour - 4 Vessels in roads, 5 berthed. Syracuse - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads, 1 berthed. Sarroch - One vessel in roads, 4 berthed. Taranto - One vessel in roads, no delays. Ravenna - Five vessels in roads. Trieste - Commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays. Trieste - SIOT oil terminal - 2 Vessels in roads, 1 berthed, some delays expected.

LATVIA, Aug 5 - No strikes. Riga - 22 Vessels in port of which 18 operating as follows, 4 timber loaders, 2 container loaders, 2 tanker loaders, 2 steel loaders, 1 fertiliser loader, 2 frozen food dischargers, 2 sugar dischargers, 3 other general cargo. 4 Vessels waiting, no delays expected. 20 Vessels due. Ventspils - Four vessels in port of which 1 steel loader, 1 mop loader. 4 Vessels waiting at outer anchorage, no delays expected. 10 Vessels due.

LITHUANIA, Aug 5 - Klaipeda - 13 Vessels in port operating of which 6 loading (3 fertiliser, 2 metal, 1 scrap). 6 Discharging (1 fish, 1 soya pellets, 2 fish meal, 2 sugar). 1 loading/discharging. 3 Vessels in roads, 27 due.

POLAND, Aug 5 - Szczecin - 32 Vessels loading at berth, 30 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 21 under repair/dry-docked, 68 due. Gdynia - Five vessels loading at berth (1 coal, 1 bulker, 3 general cargo). 3 Discharging at berth (2 grain, 1 general cargo). 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 coal waiting in roads, 9 under repair/dry-docked. 21 Vessels due. Gdansk - 10 Vessels loading at berth (2 bulkers, 1 grain, 6 general cargo, 1 coal). 2 Discharging at berth (1 general cargo, 1 tanker). 1 General cargo vessel waiting in roads, 7 under repair/dry-doed, 21 due.

PORTUGAL, Aug 4 - Leixoes - 15 Vessels operating of which 12 general cargo, 3 container vessels, no vessels waiting. Vacant places, 2 piers with cranes, 1 pier without cranes. Sines - Three vessels in port operating of which 2 discharging (1 coal, 1 crude oil). 1 loading (jet fuel/gasoil/gasoline). 3 Vessels waiting of which 2 to discharge (1 coal, 1 chemical naphtha awaiting receiver's orders). 1 to load propylene. 8 Vessels due of which 3 to discharge (1 crude, 1 coal, 1 methanol). 5 To load (2 propylene, 1 gasoline, 1 gasoil/jet fuel. 1 To be announced. Lisbon - Three vessels loading at berth, 16 discharging at berth, 4 loading/discharging at berth, 5 loading at anchorage, 1 discharging at anchorage. 3 Vessels bunkering, 18 under repair/dry-docked, 5 awaiting orders, 23 miscellaneous, 34 due. Aug 5 - Setubal - Four vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 5 under repair/dry-docked. 10 Vessels due of which 5 to discharge, 4 to load, 1 for repair/dry-dock.

ROMANIA, Aug 4 - Constantza - 30 Vessels operating of which 18 general cargo (17 loading, 1 discharging), 5 bulkers (3 loading, 2 discharging), 3 bagged cement (all loading), 2 tankers (1 loading, 1 discharging), 2 containers (both discharging). 6 Vessels waiting in roads, all to load, of which 4 general cargo, 2 bulkers. Constantza south (Agigea) - 7 Vessels operating of which 6 general cargo (4 loading, 2 discharging). 1 Bulker discharging. Mangalia - One vessel loading general cargo. Midia - Five livestock carriers loading.

RUSSIA, Aug 4 - BALTIC PORTS - st. Petersburg - 21 Vessels operating of which 14 loading (4 fertiliser, 7 non-ferrous metals, 1 coal, 1 cellulose, 1 scrap). 7 Discharging (2 frozen chicken, 2 containers, 1 frozen fish, 3 wheat). 8 Vessels waiting, 3 due. Aug 5 - No strikes. Kaliningrad - 12 Vessels in port, all operating, none waiting, no delays, 5 vessels due. Vyborg - Two vessels in port, both operating, none waiting, no delays, 4 vessels due.

BLACK SEA, Aug 4 - Novorossiysk - 15 Vessels in port operating of which 6 loading (2 scrap, 3 steel, 1 aluminium). 8 Discharging (4 sugar, 2 rice, 2 various). 1 Loading/discharging containers. 11 Vessels waiting in roads of which 8 to load (1 urea, 5 steel, 1 zinc/aluminium, 1 asbestos). 3 To discharge (1 sugar, 2 rice). 36 Vessels due of which 25 to load (1 cement, 2 scrap, 14 steel, 2 copper cathodes, 1 lead, 2 aluminium, 1 paper, 2 urea). 7 To discharge (2 sugar, 1 rice, 1 cars, 1 citrus, 2 luggage). 4 To discharge/load containers. Oil terminal - Aug 5 - 2 Tankers berthed and loading (1 crude oil, 1 diesel oil). 3 Crude oil tankers waiting in roads. 8 Tankers due to load (5 crude oil, 1 diel oil, 2 fuel oil).
NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - Four vessels operating of which 1 apatite, 1 alumina, 2 coal. No vessels waiting, 4 due during the week, all loaders, of which 1 apatite, 2 iron pellets, 1 urea.

SPAIN, Aug 5 - Pasajes - 21 Vessels in port of which 15 discharging (1 wood-pulp, 1 granite, 1 sawn timber/logs, 1 grain, 1 magnetite, 10 scrap). 3 Discharging/loading (2 cars, 1 general cargo). 3 Under repair, no delays. Cadiz - 15 Vessels operating of which 3 ro-ros, 2 sugar, 1 tobacco, 1 wheat, 1 wood, 1 ship building materials, 1 semolina, 5 under repair. No delays. Sagunto - 14 Vessels discharging (8 steel products, 2 timber, 2 fresh fruit on pallets, 1 bulk ammonia, 1 bulk fertiliser). 4 Loading (3 bulk fertiliser, 1 wood agglomerate). 4 Discharging/loading (3 ro-ros with general cargo, 1 steel products). No vessels berthed outside commercial wharf, no berthing delays.

TURKEY, Aug 4 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 8 Vessels operating of which 4 containers, 3 dry cargo, 1 ro-ro. No berthing delays. Galata - 7 Cargo/passenger vessels operating. Port congested. Ambarli - 63 Vessels operating, no berthing delays. Aug 5 - Mersin - 18 Vessels operating of which 8 loading (3 cement, 1 containers, 1 legumes, 2 soda, 1 cement clinker). 4 Discharging (1 poles, 1 bananas, 1 sun flour oil, 1 lab). 6 Loading/discharging (1 vehicles, 3 containers, 2 containers/vehicles). 6 Vessels awaiting orders. Free zone piers - 1 Vessel loading sugar, 1 discharging sugar. Seka - No vessels.

UKRAINE, Aug 4 - Mariupol - 12 Vessels in port operating of which 10 loading (4 fertiliser, 1 fire-clay, 1 coal, 3 steel, 1 large structures). 1 Discharging urea, 1 discharging/loading containers. 8 Vessels waiting in roads of which 7 to load (2 steel, 5 fertiliser), 1 to discharge/load containers. 36 Vessels due of which 29 to load (8 steel, 10 fertiliser, 5 coal, 5 fire-clay, 1 other vessel). 2 To discharge (1 clay, 1 equipment). 1 To discharge/load ore/fire-clay, 4 to discharge/load containers. Odessa - 11 Vessels in port operating of which 7 loading (1 fertiliser, 1 oil, 5 metals). 1 Discharging sugar, 3 passenger vessels. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 4 to load (3 metal, 1 steel). 1 Awaiting owners notification. 28 Vessels due of which 21 to load (2 paper, 15 metal, 1 fertiliser, 2 urea, 1 fuel oil). 1 To discharge equipment, 6 to discharge/load containers.

Ilychevsk - 10 Vessels in port operating of which 9 loading (6 steel, 2 debars, 1 potash). 1 Discharging/loading containers. 2 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 to load steel plates, 1 pig-iron. 10 Vessels due of which 5 to load (4 steel, 1 pig-iron), 2 to discharge (1 tropical oil, 1 oil). 3 To load/discharge containers. Aug 5 - Odessa - Steel cargo loaders, 9 Berthed, 4 anchored, 5 due. Containers, 1 berthed, 1 due. Tankers (loading), 2 due. General cargo, 1 berthed, 2 anchored, 1 due. Fertiliser, 1 berthed. Sugar, 1 berthed. Ilychevsk -Steel cargo loaders, 6 berthed. Containers, 1 berthed. Fertiliser, 1 berthed.

YUGOSLAVIA, Aug 5 - Bar - Four vessels berthed of which 3 loading (1 acetic acid, 1 timber, 1 lead). 1 Discharging flour, 5 ferries on the lines Bar-Bari-Bar, Bar-Koper-Bar, Bar-Bari-Ancona-Bar. Zelenika/Bijela - Two vessels berthed of which 1 discharging gasoline, 1 changing crew. 1 Vessel laid-up, 4 under repair.
